error: Merged the two converse bullets into one iff and expanded 'the command line of a run does not name the document' into an unrelated existential over Command and Ask.rel instead of the Given predicate.

error: Dropped the outer 'for every plugin' frame and read 'the checker runs no plugin over it' as a nested no-quantifier in object position, introducing a stray unused run variable.

error: Dropped the binding to conflict_1 in the final bullet, reading 'reports no finding for conflict_1' as a globally empty Finding set.

error: Read 'installed_plugin_1' as a bare Plugin, dropping the 'in Installed' restriction the numbered name implied.

error: Folded the independent fact 'every unsayable unit is explained' into the antecedent of the run/exit-code implication, as if being explained were required to trigger it.

error: Let 'implies' from the first nested bullet swallow the second bullet's whole rule, reading one big nested implication instead of two separate top-level facts.

error: Read 'leaves no unit out' compositionally, inventing a new Leave relation, instead of as the fixed idiom for 'not in Trial'.

error: Read 'the first... the second' as direction-symmetric, adding the reverse-order alternative with 'or' to both sides.
lesson: name both variables explicitly instead of 'the first/the second' when direction matters

error: Substituted the relation with the unrelated named predicate 'loneOn', echoing the prose phrase 'lone on'.
lesson: don't phrase a relation in words that match an existing predicate's name

error: Wrapped the Given check in a spurious 'no r: Run' quantifier cued by 'the command line of a run'.

error: Read 'declared, but not by that unit' as 'declared by some other unit' (allowing the unit itself to also be a declarer), rather than 'this unit specifically does not declare it'.

error: Substituted the relation with the 'loneOn' predicate call, cued by the matching words 'lone on'.
lesson: avoid prose that echoes an unrelated predicate's name

error: Attached 'Unknown' to the run instead of the command, after both 'the run' and 'the command' were repeated as generic nouns in one sentence.
lesson: give each of two co-occurring variables a distinct name instead of reusing 'the run'/'the command'

error: Read 'a finding for one... for the other' as needing to compare the documents' held units, introducing an unrelated Hold.units set-equality.

error: Read 'reports no finding for the bug or for the expected failure' as a globally empty Finding set, instead of negating membership for each named entity.

error: Read the demonstrative 'that formula' as requiring the unit to also have a statement, adding a spurious 'Stated' conjunct.
lesson: repeat the full noun phrase instead of a bare demonstrative like 'that formula'

error: Packed the universal 'reports every handwritten statement' and the anaphoric 'if there is one' into one dense sentence, folding the universal into the run's antecedent as an existential and mistyping the run as a GenerateCommand.

error: Rebuilt each of the four flaw bullets from raw relations with fresh existential variables instead of trusting the single named condition per bullet, diverging on which relation signals 'Unused'.

error: Treated the compound clause attached to the repeated placeholder 'quantifier_1' as an extra named-set filter layered on top of NoWithAnother, rather than one definition.

error: Read 'checker reports a freelancing for every spec that cites neither an axiom nor a spec' as '(some Freelancing)', dropping the binding to each spec.

error: Read 'checker reports an orphaning for every unit that is not used and is not a conflict' as '(some Orphaning)', losing the binding to each unit.
